title: PromptGuard at BLP-2025 Task 1: A Few-Shot Classification Framework Using Majority Voting and Keyword Similarity for Bengali Hate Speech Detection
findings: The study used chi-square statistical analysis to identify discriminative keywords for the 'Religious Hate' category in Bengali, including terms related to Islam (e.g., Muslim, Kafir, Mullah), Hinduism (e.g., Hindu), and Judaism (e.g., Jew). Including these keywords in the prompt improved the classification performance of the few-shot learning framework.
